fixed: shared arc junctions including degree>=3 nodes and point contacts
topology: preserve which region pairs share positive-length boundary and which only meet at points; no new intersections; preserve protected holes and region count
successful_reduction: reduce at least one nonfixed redundant arc; no global optimum required
candidate_attempts: record at least one nontrivial candidate and acceptance/rejection reason; if chosen strategy never creates an invalid candidate, demonstrate rejection with a separately proposed aggressive candidate
error: symmetric Hausdorff between each original complete arc and corresponding simplified complete arc, not just retained vertices
